digest.component_or_area: plan review vocabulary and criteria system
propositions: Success Criteria and Acceptance Criteria are two separate headings carrying one concept with no semantic distinction across all live criteria gates (F1, G3, G7, completion verifier)
Success Criteria items written as plain bullets are not counted by _count_ac_items, cannot carry [operator-attested] tags, and bypass the P1 blocking floor, creating a hidden compliance gap

Collapsing the vocabulary requires updating detector regexes, reviewer prompts, criteria routing index, author guides, generated criteria documentation, eval specs, test corpus, and 106 store tickets from bullet form to checkbox form
ADR 0053 grandfathering registry drift at the claim gate makes this rename affordable after ticket 1f32-f86e-8a51-4d8e invalidated 632 attestations

Three live sites legitimately retain success-criteria vocabulary and must be permanently excluded: plan_review_T2.md (pilot metrics), plan_review_verifier.md and plan_review_verifier_agentic.md (dod_uncertifiable wording), and verify_models.py
A sequenced expand-contract approach must accept both headings during transition so no ticket becomes un-reviewable mid-migration
